_readme.what: Scratch-test boosts for the rarest structures. Read only when CEConfig [worldgen.debug] testOverrides = true (default false, scratch servers only); the log and structure_tag_report.md then say TEST OVERRIDES ACTIVE and list every change. Rejoin to apply; new chunks only.
_readme.keys: "<structure id>" or "#<structure tag>" (structure_tags.json name, e.g. #land/mangrove): {frequency 0..1, weight >= 1, share 0..1 (a meta structure with an anchor, or a replacement)}. "groups": {"<group>": {spacing, separation}}. Tags apply first, then ids.
_readme.rule: Soft rules only (structure_tuning.md 7.4.8). Any other key (biomes, biome_rules, peaceful, priority, earth/water fill...) refuses the whole file: nothing from it is applied and the world loads as without it.
_readme.entries: Written 2026-10-30 (rates-and-groups #5, #6) from structure_group_estimates.md after the weight strip: every group member rarer than about 1 per 190 chunks, plus the fortified metas for ST-135. Each test result line names the overrides it used.
